name: ixitek-backend
description: Ixitek Solutions — Node.js / Express / SQLite backend. Handles user accounts (customers, staff, owner/admin), authentication, and storage for enquiries + career applications submitted from the website. No external database server required — everything lives in one local file via db.js. Uses node-sqlite3-wasm (pure WebAssembly, no native compilation) so it installs on hosts without a C/C++ toolchain or a recent-enough glibc, such as Hostinger's shared/VPS Node.js hosting.
